prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling subway platform. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands rigidly, holding a black umbrella vertically. Next to him, a woman in a yellow coat leans against a tiled pillar, her eyes closed in exhaustion. A brown dog sits calmly beside her, tethered by a thin leash that the woman holds loosely in her left hand. In the center, a teenager in a blue hoodie looks intently at a glowing smartphone screen, ignoring the crowd. Beside the teenager, an elderly man in a gray suit points toward the tunnel entrance, gesturing for silence. A silver briefcase rests on the floor next to the elderly man, slightly scuffed from travel. To the right, a mother in a green dress hands a small toy car to a crying child in a striped shirt. The child reaches out eagerly, tears visible on their cheeks. Behind them, a businessman in a navy tie checks his wristwatch impatiently, tapping his foot. A newspaper lies crumpled on the ground near his polished shoes. Further back, a cyclist in a helmet leans against a metal bench, resting a bicycle with a broken chain. A pigeon perches on the edge of the bench, pecking at a stray crust of bread. Above the group, a flickering fluorescent light hangs loosely from the ceiling, casting faint shadows. A vending machine stands in the far background, its glass door slightly ajar. There is no digital signage displaying train times. There is no advertisement poster on the walls. The man in the red scarf looks at the elderly man in the gray suit, creating a line of sight across the platform. The woman in the yellow coat sits on the metal bench, sharing space with the cyclist in the helmet. The teenager in the blue hoodie stands next to the silver briefcase, almost tripping over it. The mother in the green dress looks at the crying child in the striped shirt, offering comfort. The businessman in the navy tie stands next to the crumpled newspaper, seemingly unaware of the litter. The pigeon on the bench looks at the crust of bread, focused entirely on its meal.
